_ignoreComment: Both dot patterns are needed and neither covers the other.
**/.* excludes a dotfile and the dot-directory entry itself; it
does not exclude what is inside one, because .git/config has a
last segment starting with no dot. **/.*/** is that other half.
Without both, the whole of .git is served publicly.
*.json keeps test exports off the site. They are gitignored for
the same reason and this is the other door into the same room.
_rewriteComment: Two layouts, two addresses, and / is a doorway that picks one.
Short paths because they get typed on a phone at a board.
_cacheComment: Where two rules match one file the LAST wins, so broad globs go
no-cache is the default and does not mean 'do not store' — it
means 'revalidate before use'. A repeat visit gets a 304 and a
redeploy reaches a phone on the next launch instead of whenever
